notes.title: R.E.E.L. live-stream for Steam Game Festival
notes.notes:
[h3]What is the game about? [/h3]
You need to fix units of the life support system at the station on Mars. Play and learn the basics of electronics.

[h3]We are waiting for you on a live stream of the game on STEAM.  [/h3]
We will show you the R.E.E.L. and answer your questions about the game. 
As well we talk about some interesting things that await you at new levels.

notes.title: R.E.E.L. demo is updated!
notes.notes: Hi to everyone! We hear our players and reduce the number of levels where was a simple maze. So now more interesting levels will start earlier! We also updated the tutorial to make learning simpler. If you want to see all these changes, please start the game again. You just need to create a profile of a new player in the R.E.E.L.

notes.title: Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hey guys, today we are glad to represent you demo-version of our game R.E.E.L.!
R.E.E.L. is a game for everyone who wants to find out how electronics stuff works.
Play the R.E.E.L. and step by step you will know:
[list]
[*] What is inside your computer
[*] How micro schemes  work
[*] Find out real electronic components
[*] Have fun and relax solving interesting puzzles
[/list]
Learn and have fun!
